eligibility.income_limit: Family income up to 1.5 lakh to 8 lakh per annum (varies by scheme)

body_md:
## National Scholarship Portal 2026

The NSP is a one-stop platform for students to apply for scholarships offered by Central Government, State Governments, and Union Territory administrations.
meta_title: National Scholarship Portal 2026 — NSP Online Application
meta_description: Apply for central and state scholarships via National Scholarship Portal 2026. Open from July 1 to October 31.
